title: Synthetic System tower defense where you play as an alien slime mod
author: Such--Balance
selftext:
Synthetic System

[https://twosecondgames.itch.io/synthetic-system](https://twosecondgames.itch.io/synthetic-system) for the free-to-play 2 demo levels.



Working on a tower defense game where im aiming to create the feel of you being an alien high tech slime mold taking over the map and surviving the human attacks.

Its still VERY early in development. I used codex since the start for basically everything. I do like learning and programming is kinda new to me so im really taking it step by step, basically just for me to keep up. I feel like im only utilizing maybe 20% of what ai is capable of these days, but its fine.

The demo has 2 levels at the moment with 3 difficulty settings per level. The play-testers ive had so far where all struggling to finish the last wave 25 on my previous demo release. I didnt make the game easier (one tower was bugged and did nothing though), i did provide some minimal info about what towers do and how to optimally use them, although i feel thats partly up to the player to figure out. And im not gonna yellow paint my game to cater to these noobs:)

Actively developing and will be for some time. No rush in testing or downloading it. Like i said, its still very early in development. Its basically a bare bones proof of concept at this point.

Any tips on how to improve ai workflow, more than appreciated though. Especially around similar type of games.
